items.title_cn: 早期血液净化对重症急性胰腺炎血清炎症介质疗效的系统评价与Meta分析
items.title_en: Efficacy of early blood purification on serum inflammatory mediators in severe acute pancreatitis: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.abstract_cn: 重症急性胰腺炎（SAP）是急性胰腺炎（AP）最危重的形式，以失调的全身炎症反应为特征，导致早期器官衰竭和死亡。当前的管理仍以支持治疗为主。早期血液净化（EBP）已被提出作为减少循环炎症介质的辅助策略，但既往的综合分析受到试验规模小、模式异质性和报告不一致的限制。本研究旨在评估早期EBP在成人SAP中的疗效和安全性，并按治疗模式和启动时机对结局进行分层分析。研究在六个数据库（PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science、Ovid、Embase和Cochrane Library）中进行了全面检索，检索截至2026年6月发表的研究。纳入的研究对象为成人SAP患者，比较早期EBP（连续性静脉-静脉血液滤过[CVVH]、高容量血液滤过[HVHF]、联合连续性血液净化、血液灌流、血浆置换或血液吸附）与标准内科治疗。汇总效应以标准化均数差（SMD）、均数差（MD）或风险比（RR）表示，采用随机效应模型，并预先按治疗模式分层，在可行时按启动时机分层。证据确定性采用GRADE框架评估。共纳入21项研究，包含1，959名成人患者。早期EBP与IL-6（SMD = − 1.55；95% CI：−2.05至− 1.05；12项研究，n = 1，045）和CRP（SMD = − 1.14；95% CI：−1.93至− 0.34；11项研究，n = 840）的总体显著降低相关，两种标志物的效应量在不同模式间存在显著差异。APACHE II评分也显著改善（MD = − 3.40；95% CI：−4.64至− 2.15；12项研究，n = 938），血清淀粉酶、肌酐和ALT同样改善。全因死亡率显著降低（RR = 0.55；95% CI：0.41至0.74；13项研究，n = 837），无显著异质性，且在各模式亚组中效应一致。TNF-α的降低总体显著（SMD = − 1.38；95% CI：−2.37至− 0.38），但不同模式间无显著差异。SOFA评分及住院和ICU住院时间未显示一致性的显著改善。操作相关不良事件在各研究中报告不一致。所有汇总结局的证据确定性均评为极低（GRADE），反映了偏倚风险、不一致性和不精确性。SAP中的早期EBP与死亡率和关键炎症标志物的显著降低相关，同时疾病严重程度评分和生化参数也有所改善，但获益幅度因治疗模式而异。证据基础的地域集中性、各模式间的机制异质性、不良事件报告的不一致以及极低的证据确定性，均妨碍了常规推荐。在EBP能够纳入国际SAP指南之前，需要具有足够把握度的多中心随机对照试验，采用标准化方案、模式比较和安全性报告。
items.abstract_en: Severe acute pancreatitis (SAP) is the most critical form of acute pancreatitis (AP), characterized by a dysregulated systemic inflammatory response that drives early organ failure and mortality. Current management remains mainly supportive. Early blood purification (EBP) has been proposed as an adjunctive strategy to reduce circulating inflammatory mediators, yet prior syntheses have been limited by small trial sizes, heterogeneous modalities, and inconsistent reporting. This study aims to evaluate the efficacy and safety of early EBP in adults with SAP, with outcomes stratified by treatment modality and timing of initiation. A comprehensive search was conducted across six databases (PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, Ovid, Embase, and the Cochrane Library) for studies published until June, 2026. Eligible studies enrolled adults with SAP and compared early EBP (continuous veno-venous hemofiltration [CVVH], high-volume hemofiltration [HVHF], combined continuous blood purification, hemoperfusion, plasma exchange, or hemadsorption) against standard medical management. Pooled effects were expressed as standardized mean differences (SMDs), mean differences (MDs), or risk ratios (RRs) using random-effects models, stratified a priori by treatment modality and, where feasible, by timing of initiation. Certainty of evidence was assessed using the GRADE framework. Twenty-one studies comprising 1,959 adults were included. Early EBP was associated with a significant overall reduction in IL-6 (SMD = − 1.55; 95% CI: −2.05 to − 1.05; 12 studies, n = 1,045) and CRP (SMD = − 1.14; 95% CI: −1.93 to − 0.34; 11 studies, n = 840), with effect sizes differing significantly across modalities for both markers. APACHE II score also improved significantly (MD = − 3.40; 95% CI: −4.64 to − 2.15; 12 studies, n = 938), as did serum amylase, creatinine, and ALT. All-cause mortality was significantly reduced (RR = 0.55; 95% CI: 0.41 to 0.74; 13 studies, n = 837), with no significant heterogeneity and consistent effects across modality subgroups. TNF-α reduction was significant overall (SMD = − 1.38; 95% CI: −2.37 to − 0.38) but did not differ significantly by modality. SOFA score, and hospital and ICU length of stay, showed no consistent significant improvement. Procedure-related adverse events were inconsistently reported across studies. Certainty of evidence was rated very low (GRADE) for all pooled outcomes, reflecting risk of bias, inconsistency, and imprecision. Early EBP in SAP is associated with significant reductions in mortality and key inflammatory markers, alongside improvements in disease severity scores and biochemical parameters, though the magnitude of benefit varies by treatment modality. The geographically concentrated evidence base, mechanistic heterogeneity across modalities, inconsistent adverse-event reporting, and very low certainty of evidence preclude routine recommendation. Adequately powered multicenter RCTs with standardized protocols, modality comparisons, and safety reporting are needed before EBP can be incorporated into international SAP guidelines.
items.summary_cn: 这项系统综述与荟萃分析纳入21项研究、1959例重症急性胰腺炎成人患者，发现早期血液净化可显著降低IL-6、CRP、APACHE II评分及全因死亡率（RR=0.55），但SOFA评分和住院/ICU时长无一致改善，且证据确定性均为极低（GRADE）。疗效幅度因治疗模式而异，不良事件报告不一致，尚不足以支持常规推荐。

items.title_cn: 机器学习-随机生存森林预测模型预测首发急性胰腺炎短期复发
items.title_en: Machine learning–random survival forest prediction model for predicting short-term recurrence after first-episode acute pancreatitis
items.abstract_cn: 摘要 背景 本研究旨在构建并评估一种机器学习-随机生存森林预测模型，用于预测首发急性胰腺炎（AP）后的短期复发。方法 回顾性分析2018年10月至2025年12月沧州市中心医院收治的568例AP患者，根据1年内是否复发分为复发性AP组（RAP）和非RAP组。在机器学习部分，患者按7：3比例随机分为训练队列（n = 398）和内部验证队列（n = 170）。来自另一家医院的77例患者作为外部验证队列用于模型评估。应用Cox回归分析筛选复发的预测因素，并构建随机生存森林模型。采用受试者工作特征曲线、校准曲线、决策曲线分析（DCA）和Shapley加法解释（SHAP）评估随机生存森林预测模型的性能。结果 约14.1%的首发AP病例（80/568）复发。Cox分析确定饮酒（HR = 2.35，95% CI = 1.37–4.05，P = 0.002）、甘油三酯（HR = 1.13，95% CI = 1.10–1.16，P < 0.001）和胰腺坏死（HR = 5.34，95% CI = 2.11–13.54，P < 0.001）为RAP的独立预测因素。列线图预测模型在训练队列中的曲线下面积为0.834（95% CI：0.765–0.891），在内部验证队列中为0.794（95% CI：0.677–0.903），在外部验证队列中为0.794（95% CI：0.657–0.909）。重要性排名前3位的变量依次为：甘油三酯、饮酒和胰腺坏死。随机生存森林预测模型在训练队列中的曲线下面积为0.947（95% CI：0.920–0.971），在内部验证队列中为0.832（95% CI：0.711–0.931），在外部验证队列中为0.815（95% CI：0.687–0.906）。校准曲线显示随机生存森林模型具有良好的预测能力，DCA证实该模型具有较强的临床实用性。SHAP分析确定甘油三酯是最关键的预测因素，饮酒和胰腺坏死次之。结论 随机生存森林模型是预测首发AP患者短期复发的有见地且有用的工具。临床试验 不适用。
items.abstract_en: Abstract Background This study aimed to construct and assess a machine learning–random survival forest prediction model for predicting short-term recurrence after first-episode acute pancreatitis (AP). Methods A total of 568 patients with AP admitted to Cangzhou Central Hospital from October 2018 to December 2025 were retrospectively analyzed and divided into the recurrent AP group (RAP) and non-RAP group according to whether recurrence occurred within 1 year. In the machine learning section, the patients were randomly divided into a training cohort ( n = 398) and an internal validation cohort ( n = 170) at a 7:3 ratio. An external validation cohort of 77 patients from another hospital was used for model evaluation. Cox regression analysis was applied to screen the predictive factors of recurrence, and a random survival forest model was constructed. The performance of the random survival forest prediction model was assessed using the receiver operating characteristic curve, calibration curve, decision curve analysis (DCA), and Shapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP). Results Approximately 14.1% of the first-episode AP cases (80/568) recurred. Cox analysis identified alcohol drinking (HR = 2.35, 95% CI = 1.37–4.05, P = 0.002), triglyceride (HR = 1.13, 95% CI = 1.10–1.16, P < 0.001), and pancreatic necrosis (HR = 5.34, 95% CI = 2.11–13.54, P < 0.001) as independent predictive factors of RAP. The nomogram prediction model achieved an area under the curve of 0.834 (95% CI: 0.765–0.891) in the training cohort, 0.794 (95% CI: 0.677–0.903) in the internal validation cohort, and 0.794 (95% CI: 0.657–0.909) in the external validation cohort. The top 3 variables in terms of importance were ranked as follows: triglyceride, alcohol drinking, and pancreatic necrosis. The random survival forest prediction model achieved an area under the curve of 0.947 (95% CI: 0.920–0.971) in the training cohort, 0.832 (95% CI: 0.711–0.931) in the internal validation cohort, and 0.815 (95% CI: 0.687–0.906) in the external validation cohort. The calibration curve showed that the random survival forest model had good predictive ability, and DCA confirmed that the model had strong clinical utility. SHAP analysis identified triglyceride as the most critical predictor, with secondary contributions from alcohol drinking and pancreatic necrosis. Conclusion Random survival forest models are insightful and useful tools for predicting short-term recurrence for patients with first-episode AP. Clinical trail Not applicable.
items.journal: BMC Medical Informatics and Decision Making
items.summary_cn: 该研究构建了随机生存森林模型预测首发急性胰腺炎1年内短期复发，发现饮酒、甘油三酯和胰腺坏死是独立预测因素，模型在训练、内部验证和外部验证队列中AUC分别为0.947、0.832和0.815，SHAP分析显示甘油三酯为最重要预测因子。

items.title_cn: CRP/白蛋白比值与部分实验室指标在太原中央医院急性胰腺炎患者中的研究
items.title_en: TỶ SỐ CRP/ALBUMIN VÀ MỘT SỐ CHỈ SỐ CẬN LÂM SÀNG Ở BỆNH NHÂN VIÊM TỤY CẤP TẠI BỆNH VIỆN TRUNG ƯƠNG THÁI NGUYÊN
items.abstract_cn: 急性胰腺炎是一种常见的胃肠道急症，临床表现多样，其重症形式可能危及生命。CRP/白蛋白比值是反映全身炎症和营养状态的标志物，可用于预测急性胰腺炎的严重程度。目的：通过分析泰国阮国家医院急性胰腺炎的受试者工作特征（ROC）曲线下面积（AUC），评估C反应蛋白与白蛋白比值对2012年修订版亚特兰大分类所定义的重症急性胰腺炎的预测价值。对象与方法：在泰国阮国家医院对166例急性胰腺炎患者进行了横断面研究。结果：根据修订版亚特兰大分类，40例患者（24.1%）被归类为重症AP，91例患者（54.8%）为轻症AP，35例患者（21.1%）为中重症AP。血浆CRP、白蛋白水平及CRP/白蛋白比值对急性胰腺炎的严重程度均显示出良好的预测价值，相应的AUC值分别为0.88、0.90和0.95（95% CI：0.82–0.93；0.85–0.95；0.92–0.98），在相应的截断值200.5 mg/L、37.3 g/L和5.11处，灵敏度和特异度分别为84.1%和81.9%；82.5%和89.9%；88.1%和87.9%。结论：CRP、白蛋白水平及CRP/白蛋白比值是预测急性胰腺炎严重程度的有用指标。
items.abstract_en: Acute pancreatitis is a common gastrointestinal emergency with diverse clinical manifestations and its severe forms may be life-threatening. The CRP/albumin ratio, a marker reflecting systemic inflammation and nutritional status, may be used to predict the severity of acute pancreatitis. Objective: To evaluate the predictive value of the C-reactive protein-to-albumin ratio for severe acute pancreatitis, as defined by the 2012 Revised Atlanta Classification, by analyzing the area under the receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve (AUC) of acute pancreatitis at Thai Nguyen National Hospital. Subjects and methods: A cross-sectional study was conducted on 166 patients with acute pancreatitis at Thai Nguyen National Hospital. Results: According to the revised Atlanta classification, 40 patients (24.1%) were classified as having severe AP, while 91 patients (54.8%) had mild AP and 35 patients (21.1%) had morderate AP. Plasma CRP, albumin level and the CRP/albumin ratio showed good predictive value for the severity of acute pancreatitis, with corresponding AUC values of 0.88, 0.90, and 0.95 (95% CI: 0.82–0.93; 0.85–0.95; and 0.92–0.98, respectively) at the corresponding cut-off points of 200.5 mg/L, 37.3 g/L, and 5.11, the sensitivity and specificity were 84.1% and 81.9%; 82.5% and 89.9%; 88.1% and 87.9%, respectively. Conclusion: CRP, albumin level and the CRP/albumin ratio are useful indicators for predicting the severity of acute pancreatitis.
items.journal: Tạp chí Y học Cộng đồng
items.summary_cn: 该研究在166例急性胰腺炎患者中评估了CRP/白蛋白比值对重症急性胰腺炎的预测价值，发现其AUC达0.95（95%CI 0.92–0.98），优于单独CRP（AUC 0.88）和白蛋白（AUC 0.90），在cut-off值5.11时敏感度和特异度分别为88.1%和87.9%。结论认为CRP、白蛋白及CRP/白蛋白比值均是预测急性胰腺炎严重程度的有用指标。

items.title_cn: 个体化方法在优化慢性胰腺炎治疗中的重要性
items.title_en: THE IMPORTANCE OF AN INDIVIDUAL APPROACH IN OPTIMIZING TREATMENT IN CHRONIC PANCREATITIS
items.abstract_cn: 慢性胰腺炎是一种胰腺的长期炎症纤维化疾病，其临床过程表现为疼痛综合征、消化不良症状、外分泌功能不全及代谢紊乱。在治疗该疾病时，仅将管理局限于缓解疼痛或使实验室指标恢复正常是不够的。有必要采用个体化方法，综合考虑患者的临床状况、疾病持续时间、合并的肝胆系统病变、外分泌功能不全的程度、饮食模式以及居住地区的气候特征。
items.abstract_en: Chronic pancreatitis is a long-term inflammatory-fibrotic disease of the pancreas, and its clinical course is manifested by pain syndrome, dyspeptic symptoms, exocrine insufficiency, and metabolic disorders. In the treatment of the disease, it is not sufficient to limit management only to pain relief or normalization of laboratory parameters. It is necessary to apply an individual approach, taking into account the patient’s clinical condition, disease duration, concomitant hepatobiliary pathologies, degree of exocrine insufficiency, dietary pattern, and the climatic characteristics of the area of residence.
items.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
items.summary_cn: 慢性胰腺炎是一种长期炎症纤维化疾病，临床表现为疼痛综合征、消化不良症状、外分泌功能不全和代谢紊乱。治疗不应仅限于缓解疼痛或使实验室指标正常化，而需采用个体化方法，综合考虑患者的临床状况、病程、合并肝胆病理、外分泌功能不全程度、饮食模式及居住地区的气候特征。

items.title_cn: 评估强化胰岛素治疗在高甘油三酯血症性急性胰腺炎管理中的疗效：系统评价与荟萃分析
items.title_en: Evaluating the efficacy of intensified insulin therapy in hypertriglyceridemic acute pancreatitis management: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.abstract_cn: 背景 高甘油三酯血症长期以来被视为胰腺炎的主要原因之一，其发病率逐年上升。然而，强化胰岛素治疗在高甘油三酯血症性急性胰腺炎（HTG-AP）治疗中的作用仍存在争议。方法 通过检索PubMed、Cochrane Library、Embase数据库以及Web of Science，开展了一项前瞻性注册的荟萃分析（CRD420261344642），以审查符合条件的随机对照试验（RCT）或回顾性观察性研究（ROS），检索时间截至2026年3月1日。根据预设标准筛选符合条件的荟萃分析。数据分析使用RevMan（5.4版）和R（4.4.3版）进行。结果 共纳入12项研究，包含1，505例患者，比较了强化胰岛素治疗与其他治疗方式在HTG-AP患者中的有效性。结果显示，强化胰岛素治疗与其他治疗在降低甘油三酯方面差异无统计学意义（强化胰岛素治疗与其他治疗：24hTG，MD：1.25，95%CI：−0.53至3.03，P = 0.17；48hTG，MD：0.07，95%CI：−0.79至0.93，P = 0.88；72hTG，MD：−0.54，95%CI：−3.36至2.27，P = 0.71）。同样，血液净化治疗也未显著降低甘油三酯（强化胰岛素治疗与血液净化：24hTG，MD：1.47，95%CI：−1.24至4.19，P = 0.29；48hTG，MD：0.72，95%CI：−0.69至2.13，P = 0.32；72hTG，MD：1.89，95%CI：−2.22至6.00，P = 0.37）。此外，强化胰岛素治疗与胰腺局部并发症或全身不良事件发生率的升高无关。与接受血液净化方案的队列相比，强化胰岛素治疗患者的住院时间显著缩短（MD：−3.60，95%CI：−5.09至−2.11，P < 0.01）。结论 当前证据未显示强化胰岛素治疗或血液净化中任一方的优越性，但强化胰岛素治疗可能在一定程度上缩短住院时间。系统综述注册 https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO/view/CRD420261344642 ，PROSPERO CRD420261344642。
items.abstract_en: Background Hypertriglyceridemia has long been regarded as a major cause of pancreatitis, and its incidence has been increasing annually. However, the role of intensified insulin therapy in treating hypertriglyceridemic acute pancreatitis (HTG-AP) remains debatable. Methods A prospectively registered meta-analysis (CRD420261344642) was conducted to examine eligible randomized controlled trials (RCTs) or retrospective observational studies (ROSs) through searches across PubMed, Cochrane Library, and Embase databases, as well as the Web of Science, with a search period up to 1st March 2026. Eligible meta-analyses were selected based on predefined criteria. Data analysis was conducted using RevMan (version 5.4) and R (version 4.4.3). Results A total of 12 studies including 1,505 patients were identified that compared the effectiveness of intensive insulin therapy with other treatment modalities in patients with HTG-AP. The results revealed a statistically non-significant difference in triglyceride reduction between intensive insulin therapy and other treatments (intensive insulin therapy versus other therapy: 24hTG, MD: 1.25, 95%CI: −0.53 to 3.03, P = 0.17; 48hTG, MD: 0.07, 95%CI: −0.79 to 0.93, P = 0.88; 72hTG, MD: −0.54, 95%CI: −3.36 to 2.27, P = 0.71. Similarly, triglycerides were not significantly reduced with blood purification therapy (intensive insulin therapy versus blood purification: 24hTG, MD: 1.47, 95%CI: −1.24 to 4.19, P = 0.29; 48hTG, MD: 0.72, 95%CI: −0.69 to 2.13, P = 0.32; 72hTG, MD: 1.89, 95%CI: −2.22 to 6.00, P = 0.37). Additionally, intensive insulin therapy was not associated with a higher incidence of local pancreatic complications or systemic adverse effects. Intensive insulin therapy experienced a significantly reduced duration of hospital stay in comparison to the cohort receiving the blood purification regimen (MD: −3.60, 95%CI: −5.09 to −2.11, P < 0.01). Conclusions Current evidence does not demonstrate the superiority of either intensive insulin therapy or blood purification, but intensive insulin therapy may shorten the length of hospital stay to a certain extent. Systematic Review Registration https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO/view/CRD420261344642 , PROSPERO CRD420261344642.
items.summary_cn: 该荟萃分析纳入12项研究共1505例高甘油三酯性急性胰腺炎患者，发现强化胰岛素治疗在降低甘油三酯方面与其他治疗及血液净化相比无显著差异，且未增加局部胰腺并发症或全身不良事件，但可显著缩短住院时间。

items.title_cn: 中重度及重度急性胰腺炎心肌损伤预测的临床-影像学模型构建与验证
items.title_en: Development and validation of a clinical-radiological model for predicting myocardial injury in moderately severe and severe acute pancreatitis
items.summary_cn: 该论文标题表明其开发并验证了一个临床-影像学模型，用于预测中重症和重症急性胰腺炎患者的心肌损伤。由于摘要未提供，无法总结具体发现。

items.title_cn: 用于超快生物粘附和黏膜下注射的水凝胶
items.title_en: Hydrogels for ultrafast bio-adhesion and submucosal injection
items.abstract_en: Bio-adhesive hydrogels and lifting gels comprising sodium alginate and their use for preventing or controlling a gastrointestinal bleed or hemorrhage or sealing a perforation in tissue of a GI tract and separating diseased tissue from normal tissue in the GI tract, respectively, are disclosed. The hydrogel forms a calcium alginate barrier at the bleeding site, addressing the limitations of current endoscopic treatments for gastrointestinal bleeding which have limited efficacy, high recurrence of bleeding, and obscuration of the endoscopy view.
items.abstract_cn: 本发明公开了包含海藻酸钠的生物粘附水凝胶和抬举凝胶，分别用于预防或控制胃肠道出血或止血、封闭胃肠道组织穿孔，以及将病变组织与正常组织分离。该水凝胶在出血部位形成海藻酸钙屏障，解决了当前胃肠道出血内镜治疗疗效有限、再出血率高、以及内镜视野被血液遮挡的问题。同时可作为黏膜下注射抬举凝胶用于ESD术中组织分离。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由约翰斯·霍普金斯大学研发，提出一种基于海藻酸钠和CaCl₂的生物粘附水凝胶，在内镜下喷洒至出血部位后迅速形成海藻酸钙屏障实现止血。其核心创新在于兼具止血和黏膜下抬举双重功能：既能控制急性出血和迟发性出血，又能在ESD术中作为抬举凝胶分离病变组织与正常组织。优势在于减少多种内镜配件的使用需求，缩短操作时间，适用于难以精确定位的弥漫性出血和肿瘤出血场景。
items.assignee: JOHNS HOPKINS UNIVERSITY（美国约翰斯·霍普金斯大学）

items.title_cn: 用于机器人辅助手术的内镜多装夹施夹器
items.title_en: Endoscopic clip applier for robotic-assisted surgery
items.abstract_en: An endoscopic multi-load clip applier device includes a housing structured to include a compartment operable to store and distribute one or more clips; a flexible end coupled to the housing; and at least two grip components coupled to the housing and operable to compress and release upon control by robotic forceps of a robotic-assisted surgery system. The device enables multiple clip storage and automatic reloading, enhancing surgical efficiency and surgeon control in robotic-assisted surgery. The instrument can be introduced into an operative field via a bedside assistant port, and the surgeon can pick up the device using robotic forceps to place clips at the surgical site.
items.abstract_cn: 一���内镜多装夹施夹器装置，包括可存储和分发多个钛夹的壳体、连接于壳体的柔性端部、以及至少两个夹持组件。夹持组件可由机器人辅助手术系统的机械钳控制压缩和释放，使术者可在术中多次放置钛夹。该装置支持多夹存储和自动重装，提升机器人辅助手术中的效率和术者操控性。器械可通过床旁助手端口引入手术区域，术者使用机械钳夹取器械端部并在手术部位放置钛夹。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由加州大学研发，针对机器人辅助手术中血管结扎的痛点，设计了一种可存储多个钛夹并自动重装的内镜施夹器。核心创新在于将柔性端部设计与机器人机械钳操控相结合，术者可在不更换器械的情况下连续放置多个止血夹，大幅提升手术效率。该装置为一次性使用，成本低于现有技术，适用于机器人辅助的消化道手术中血管处理。
items.assignee: UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA（美国加州大学）
